description: Scrape product profiles, public reviews, market product listings, and the Gartner market directory.

includeProductDetails.description: When on, market mode fetches each product profile and its reviews instead of writing the fast market listing records.
includeProductDetails.title: Fetch full product details in market mode

lastTwelveMonths.description: Limit reviews to those published in the last twelve months.
lastTwelveMonths.title: Only reviews from the last 12 months

marketCompanySize.description: Use Gartner's company-size facet when listing products in a market.
marketCompanySize.title: Filter market products by company size

marketSeoName.description: Gartner market slug or full market URL, e.g. sales-force-automation-platforms or https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/sales-force-automation-platforms. Used in market mode.
marketSeoName.title: Market

marketSort.description: How products are ordered inside a market listing.
marketSort.title: Market product sort order

maxItems.description: Maximum number of market, product, review, or category records to save.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum public reviews to collect for each product. Set 0 to collect only the product profile. Reviews are paged until this limit or the public review list ends.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product

mode.description: Choose what to collect: product profiles with reviews, a market's product listing, or the full market and category directory.
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Gartner Peer Insights product page URLs or product slugs, e.g. https://www.gartner.com/reviews/product/salesforce-sales-performance-management or salesforce-sales-performance-management. Used in products mode.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or slugs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy and switches automatically only if Gartner blocks the request.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

reviewRating.description: Collect only reviews with this star rating, or all ratings.
reviewRating.title: Filter reviews by star rating

reviewSort.description: How Gartner orders public reviews before paging.
reviewSort.title: Review sort order

reviewerType.description: Collect reviews from all reviewers, end users, or vendor partners.
reviewerType.title: Filter reviews by reviewer type

useFilters.description: After paging, query each star rating once to surface additional unique public reviews. Has no effect when a specific star rating is selected below.
useFilters.title: Add star-rating passes for more reviews

title: Gartner Peer Insights Scraper Input
